data.content:
EcoToxFred here. Based on the graph query, Iomeprol was identified as a mixture risk driver at 37 distinct sites in Germany in 2010 (73 site–quarter occurrences across Q1–Q4).

Examples of sites (from the results sample):
- adlermuhle (Weisse Elster) — 2010-Q3
- Bad Düben (Vereinigte Mulde) — 2010-Q1, Q2, Q4
- Bad Elster (Weisse Elster) — 2010-Q1
- Canitz — present in 2010 (appears in 4 quarters)

Would you like me to fetch and list all 37 site names? If you have access to the database, you can run the following Cypher query to retrieve the complete list (all site–quarter rows are included):

```
MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:IS_DRIVER]->(l:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'Iomeprol'
  AND l.country = 'Germany'
  AND r.year = 2010
RETURN DISTINCT
  l.name AS SiteName,
  l.water_body AS WaterBody,
  l.river_basin AS RiverBasin,
  r.year AS Year,
  r.quarter AS Quarter
ORDER BY SiteName, Year, Quarter
```

Complete database access:
- Neo4j graph (Docker container): https://zenodo.org/records/14616124

If you want, I can also return just the distinct site names (one per site) in a clean list.
